_note: Organization of the 19 supervisor and manager courses (sm-*) and their standalone job aids (ja-sm-*): reviewed themes, legacy theme URLs, the course's learning level, the job aid's progression level, development journeys, Ask intents and tags. Read by lib/content/supervisor-job-aids.ts and scripts/content/register-supervisor-job-aids.mjs.

sm-first-week.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: A new supervisor's first duties on reports, requests and contract checks are workforce and leadership practice.

sm-fair-assignments.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Consistent criteria for assignments, schedules and visibility shape everyday work experience.

sm-rating-and-what-follows.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Ratings and the pay, award and opportunity decisions that follow are staff development practice.

sm-corrective-action.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Corrective action under a labor agreement is supervision practice bounded by contract and policy.

sm-hiring-decisions.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Criteria-first hiring and selection records are workforce practice.

sm-named-in-complaint.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Conduct while named in a complaint concerns supervision, retaliation and the team's everyday work.

sm-leave-and-return.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Leave, coverage and return to work join supervision with accommodation and disability-informed practice.

sm-budget-cuts-separation.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Input, criteria and conversations during cuts and reassignment are supervision and leadership practice.

sm-your-own-load.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: A supervisor's own workload and well-being are workplace culture and staff development subjects.

sm-who-carries-equity-work.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Who carries equity work concerns fair assignment and the identity-linked burden on staff of color, disabled and bilingual staff.

sm-deaf-deafblind-hoh.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Supervising Deaf, DeafBlind and hard of hearing colleagues is communication access, disability-informed practice and supervision.

sm-rules-fall-2026.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: A dated map of state duties, civil rights law and enforcement positions orients supervisors to policy.

sm-why-this-is-supervisor-work.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: What the evidence says about training, and where everyday decisions set outcomes, connects supervision with leadership and evidence.

sm-backing-your-supervisors.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Conversation guides a manager uses with a supervisor before a decision are leadership support for supervision practice.

sm-calibration.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Comparing how standards are applied across supervisors before decisions are final is leadership practice built on evidence.

sm-reading-patterns.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Reading workforce and service patterns and turning them into process questions is evidence and leadership practice.

sm-fair-oversight.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Fair oversight in program integrity concerns program decisions, records someone else can check and pattern review.

sm-senior-leader-sessions.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Voluntary senior leader decision sessions are leadership and organizational change practice.

sm-facilitator-guide.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Hosting an optional live practice session is learning facilitation with access planned before anyone is invited.
